profile.headline: R&D Imagineer at Disney
profile.summary:
I have spent the past four years at Embodied Inc. developing systems and toolchains for intelligent interactive characters.

While at Embodied, I helped ship their first product, Moxie: a intelligent interactive robot helping kids develop social and emotional skills.  Leveraging both my technical skills and creative background, I bridged the gap between design goals and technical limitations, helping bring to life some of Moxie's most popular activities.

With my experience transposing design documents into code, I was shifted to tools development.  Working with a small team, I helped design and build a proprietary toolchain from the ground up.  This tool empowered our designers to create activities for Moxie with minimal to no technical support.

Currently seeking a high performance team bringing a new project to life.

positions.title: Software Developer, Interactive Design III
positions.description: Lead developer for a real-time NLP-driven conversational  pipeline converting proprietary authoring tool scripts into executable code.

positions.title: Software Developer, Interactive Design
positions.description: Tools development and core programming support for the Design Team in crafting real-time NLP-driven conversational experiences.

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description: Contributed to the design and development of Moxie’s core Content Management System.

positions.title: Part Time VR Technician
positions.description: I operate the Virtual Reality experience "Tree" at events and shows.  This includes calibrating the Oculus environment, guiding patrons through the experience, and operating the 4-D elements.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: I worked in numerous positions across different dining locations throughout my time at Brandeis.  I was a sandwich maker at the on Campus Einsteins Bagel Bros., cashier at the on campus convince store, and worked in the student cafeterias.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I assisted NRC with any task they required.  This includes running their VR experience Tree at conventions and shows, taking notes during meetings and phone calls, sending emails to host venues, and sending the occasional package.
